item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\np={'edges':{'a>b':{},'b>c':{'role':'op'}},'retry_limit':2}\\ncases=[({'from':'a','to':'b'}, {'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),({'from':'x','to':'y'}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),({'from':'b','to':'c','retry':True,'attempts':99}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','retry':True,'attempts':0}, {'ok':True,'value':'c','reason':'ok'}),({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','retry':True,'attempts':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','retry':True,'attempts':True}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','retry':True,'attempts':-1}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})]\\nfor req,want in cases:\\n rb=copy.deepcopy(req); pb=copy.deepcopy(p); got=evaluate(req,p); assert got==want,(req,got,want); assert req==rb and p==pb\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: rs=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: pol=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nassert report==[evaluate(r,pol) for r in rs]\\nprint('all checks passed')\"]}"}
